releaseNotes:
Nokiatis MUC 1.17.4-beta.1 — the fixes you asked for, one by one.

• THE BOTTOM BAR HIGHLIGHT IS A TRUE CIRCLE: the green highlight behind the selected tab at the base of the screen is now a perfect circle — an explicit pixel radius plus a circular glow bitmap, so no theme, corner style or screen switch can ever square it again.
• LYRICS REBUILT FROM ZERO: the new v4 engine races every source at once and shows the first correct match immediately — a hot in-memory cache plus fetching the moment a song starts means lyrics are there from the first second, word-level sync locked to a 50fps clock.
• THE CURRENT LYRIC LINE IN THE PLAYER: open the player and you'll see the line being sung right now as a small quiet line under the title — it fades between lines and opens the full lyrics when you tap it.
• MADE FOR YOU: the app now detects the artists you hear the most and the albums you play the most, and builds your own Made For You section — one Daily Mix per top artist, plus your most-played albums.
• DOWNLOADS ARE MANUAL, ALWAYS: automatic downloading is now OFF for everyone — smart cache, offline mixtape and liked-song auto-download are off by default. Want a song (and its lyrics) offline? Press Download yourself.
• NO MORE PODCAST/GLITCH NEXT: a song is always followed by a song. Podcasts, interviews, leaks, snippets, hour loops and random videos are hard-filtered out of autoplay, radio, recommendations and search results, and recommendation searches now query songs only.
• SEARCH CLEANED UP: obvious junk uploads are dropped and music-first ranking is stronger.

Installs over your current version — nothing is lost. Beta channel stays skippable, never locks the app.

— الهالة في شريط الأسفل صارت دائرة حقيقية نهائيًا، محرك كلمات الأغاني بُني من الصفر بسرعة فورية وتزامن بمستوى Spotify، وسطر الكلمات الحالي يظهر داخل المشغّل، وقسم صُنع لك يتعلّم أكثر الفنانين والألبومات التي تسمعها، والتنزيل صار يدويًا بالكامل، والأغنية التالية أغنية دائمًا — لا بودكاست ولا فيديوهات عشوائية.
